about: Gap probes: questions the docs do not answer, for calibrating a chatbot's 'the docs don't cover this' threshold. Written 2026-10-11, committed before scoring. Each was checked against the full text of all 4,877 indexed sections (2026-10-11): the topic is absent, or appears only in an unrelated sense. Two are deliberate near-misses: the docs cover editor comments (not reader comments on a site) and billing credit cards (not taking payments on a site). Candidates the docs did answer were dropped: on-premises installs (answered: SaaS only) and Kubernetes (answered: AKS deployment).

questions.q: can I install wordpress plugins in agility
how do readers leave comments on my blog posts
